t: What Pessimistic Locking Internals Is All About
title: What Pessimistic Locking Internals Is All About
description: Lock before you touch: shared/exclusive locks, two-phase locking, and deadlock.. This database covers Pessimistic Locking Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
definition: Pessimistic Locking Internals — Lock before you touch: shared/exclusive locks, two-phase locking, and deadlock.
key_points: ACID is a contract: atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability.
Atomicity means all-or-nothing; undo logs implement it.
Durability means surviving crashes; WAL implements it.
Isolation is a spectrum; serializable is the top.

Choose the isolation level: read-committed default, serializable for invariants.
Keep it short: do all reads, then writes, then commit; no user input inside.
Order lock acquisition consistently to prevent deadlocks.
